description: An auto-fix function concatenates an untrusted PR diff directly into a model prompt with no delimiter (LLM01 Prompt Injection), then parses the model's JSON output with no schema validation and applies it as a direct file write with no check that the model-supplied filePath is actually one of the PR's own changed files (LLM06 Excessive Agency / unsafe tool-use).

required_findings.exploit_preconditions: The attacker only needs to get text into the PR diff (a comment, a string literal, a commit message included in the diff) — no special access beyond opening a PR, since diffText is concatenated with no delimiter distinguishing it from the surrounding instruction text.

Requires the prompt-injection finding (req-1) to succeed in getting the model to emit an attacker-chosen filePath/newContent pair; this finding is about the missing second layer of defense (no schema validation, no diff-membership check on filePath) that would otherwise contain that failure.

explanation: Combines two distinct LLM Top 10:2025 categories from §3.17 in one fixture, each with its own vulnerable-pattern snippet in the spec: LLM01 Prompt Injection (diffText concatenated into the prompt with no delimiter — matches §3.17's first vulnerable snippet exactly) and LLM06 Excessive Agency (JSON.parse'd model output applied directly via a file-write tool with no diff-membership check on the model-supplied path — matches §3.17's second vulnerable snippet exactly). A reviewer should raise both as separate findings (different root causes, different remediations — delimiters/system-prompt framing for one, schema validation plus a known-file-list cross-check for the other) rather than merging them into one, even though the second is only exploitable as a consequence of the first succeeding.
